newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 6.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 7 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Millions of dollars of dirty money originating from Russia are being laundered in Germany.
- The Russian business community says it is interested in stepping up trade with Spain.
- The Nizhny Novgorod region holds its 200th land auction.
- The head of a coal-mining company in the small Russian town of Inta situated beyond the Arctic circle has gone on a hungerstrike in protest against wage payment delays.

- Two members of a satanic sect in the Siberian town of Krasnoyarsk who raped their victims and eventually killed one of them have been sentenced to long prison terms. --Andrei Shukshin, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
